title: Governance by Construction
thesis: Softanza's signature, the one capability where it out-covers .NET, Python, Wolfram and the JVM alike: safety is architectural, not procedural. An LLM (or any untrusted capability) cannot act effectfully by construction -- it holds only the inference capability, granting it effectful raises at construction, and effectful work rehearses in a semantic virtual world whose only export is a reviewable update plan a governed actor commits; one rule gate then judges the result across eleven domains. 'We will not build safe agents. We will build a safe world, and let ordinary agents loose inside it.'

lanes.note: stzAgentGraph gives every actor a capability set and taint colour; AddLLMActor grants [inference] only and Grant(llm, effectful) raises at construction

lanes.lane: The safe world -- rehearse -> plan -> commit
lanes.note: stzVirtualSystem + stzVirtualFileSystem are a real in-memory twin (snapshots, branches, tombstones); the tick's only export is a reviewable stzUpdatePlan
stzUpdatePlan.Execute() passes every operation through reviewer, commit scope and capability gates; MayCommit() refuses the LLM's plan before any attempt
stzRuleReport collects findings in one shape with IsSound() from 11 self-checking domains; stzPredicateSet is the signable, sha256-sealed constitution
create_file, set_var, spawn_process, change_dir are stzVirtualOperations requiring effectful; a focused set (files/env/process), not the whole syscall surface
All reads self-redact; Reveal(name, actor) is gated to an effectful, non-sandboxed actor, so an inference-only LLM cannot reveal; refusals log the name only
stzSecurityLedger is append-only and hash-chained, Verify() names the first broken link, SealTo(path,key) is keyed HMAC-SHA256; not append-proof in-process
stzServiceRegistry asks each service its posture; SetPhase(:production) raises sandbox-in-production and ephemeral-in-production; the sandboxes are genuine
23 files in base/security: stzAuth, OIDC, SAML, passkey, TOTP, request signer, Posture/Attestation/Drill/Sentinel/Detection/Incident; composes known protocols

lanes.lane: Governance as a file -- the .pia agent
lanes.note: stzAgentDeclaration compiles a .pia agent to the same classes and quotes Grant's refusal verbatim; pia: 2 refuses a ring: clause with no declared posture
The plan reaches the agent (stzAgentWorkbench + GiveWorkbench, 2026-08-22) but Receive/Revise, stzAgentEvaluation and branch-per-hypothesis are design-only
No formal capability type (string kinds; raw SetNodeProperty bypasses Grant), the registration gate is opt-in, the ring: escape checks name not behaviour

standouts: Safety is architectural, not procedural: an LLM cannot act effectfully because it never holds the capability
A semantic sandbox whose only export is a reviewable, rejectable update plan, not an opaque container
One rule gate judging code, agents, services, security and diagram models across 11 domains
Production refuses fakes by construction: sandbox-in-production raises, and the sandboxes are genuine
gaps: A formal capability type that cannot be forged around Grant
Flip the engine-loop registration gate (MayRegister) to default
Close the ring: escape with a behavioural check, and wire the native agent roster
The negotiation loop (Receive/Revise), the evaluation hall and branches, and stzHybridAgent
